mintAuthority.summary: OUSD is minted 1:1 when users deposit USDC into the Origin OUSD Vault, but the protocol also runs a Curve AMO that pre-mints OUSD into protocol-owned liquidity and deploys USDC into Morpho/Curve strategies under privileged owner/Governor/Strategist roles.

mintIncidents.summary: Origin Dollar's VaultCore mint logic was exploited through missing validation and reentrancy checks, inflating OUSD supply and draining about $7.7M from the vault.

controls.label: OUSD Vault (user mint/redeem)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095831, the OUSD token vaultAddress() names 0xe75d77b1865ae93c7eaa3040b038d7aa7bc02f70. Vault governor() and admin() both name 0x35918cde7233f2dd33fa41ae3cb6ae0e42e0e69f; implementation() remains 0x82948060c4b72684bededec342350ab344975145. User minting and redemption semantics are documented by Origin.

controls.label: OUSD Timelock (48h) + Origin Governance (AMO/strategy admin)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095831, the OUSD token and Vault admin()/governor() reads identify Timelock 0x35918cde7233f2dd33fa41ae3cb6ae0e42e0e69f. Its getMinDelay() returns 172800 seconds. Previously enumerated proposer roles remain historical and were not re-enumerated in this review.

controls.label: OUSD Strategist Safe (strategy allocation)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095831, Vault strategistAddr() remains 0x4ff1b9d9ba8558f5eafcec096318ea0d8b541971. The Safe has eight current owners, threshold 2, a zero guard storage slot, and five enabled modules: 0x6241f5e4ad5af39ef3ae54801e0ae431e0b70369, 0x6320db7a3c1b95fd5684dc725c2cda9b82fa20fa, 0x90d588fc0ec3db9c4b417db4537fe08e063d2ae5, 0x1b84e64279d63f48ddd88b9b2a7871e817152a44, 0x630c1763d38abe76301f58909fa174e7b84a7ecd. This contradicts the earlier no-enabled-modules observation; module capabilities were not inferred from their addresses.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530882, token admin() and governor() and Vault admin() and governor() all returned the 48-hour Timelock 0x35918cde7233f2dd33fa41ae3cb6ae0e42e0e69f. implementation() returned 0xa7b7c59a1705e4a624ea8a4ad8a06f9de22dcc33 for the token and 0x82948060c4b72684bededec342350ab344975145 for the Vault. Timelock getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. The same Timelock controls the Vault mint/AMO administration path, so mint-critical logic can change after the recorded delay. User issuance deposits reserve assets into the Vault, while any expansion through AMO or changed mint logic remains behind that independently enforced 48-hour delay; economic cap semantics are raiseable rather than the direct-call encoding's unbounded value. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: mint-critical changes traverse the 48-hour timelock, live on-chain vault balances cover the full USDC reserve basket, and no regulator or independent attestor is evidenced.
